registry.description:
Render a page or crop of the supplied source PDF. Crop coordinates are normalized [left, top, right, bottom], with origin at the page's top left. No external files.

Use inspect_source to inspect the supplied PDF and make your own crops. Use save_draft early, even for an incomplete draft, and after meaningful changes. It preserves your draft and returns notation/meter checks, never reference answers. Set complete=true only for your final complete best-effort transcription. Only the supplied PDF and your own work are available. Completion policy completion_gate_v1: a final claim is accepted only when notation, meter and executable-route issues are resolved. Save feedback contains completion_gate with exact issue IDs and the ABC hash. Inspect nearby notation and parallel passages in this PDF, correct the draft and save again. Never pad rests mechanically. If the manuscript itself has an irregular bar or unpaired pickup, record a source exception in resolutions citing an earlier inspect_source call. Include the current abc_sha256, issue_id, category, location, adopted_choice, reason and uncertainty. An uncertain pitch is a documented best-effort choice, not permission to ignore meter. Preserve partial progress if time runs out; do not claim human approval.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__source__inspect_source(args: { crop?: Array<number>; dpi?: 160 | 240 | 320; page: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

registry.description:

Resolve every issue or record an evidenced source-meter exception in resolutions; unknown or stale exceptions block completion.


start: pragma_source | plain_source

plain_source: SOURCE

tools.name: exec

tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.
tools.name: wait

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.
